subject: storytime
title: The Snowy Day words
about: Peter wakes up to find his city covered in snow and spends the day making tracks, sliding down a hill and saving a snowball in his pocket for later. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the snow words.

book.author: Ezra Jack Keats
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A small boy's quiet, happy day out in the first big snow of the winter.
